body: Decision card v1 for Uttam Sugar Mills Ltd (integrated sugar, distillery, co-generation; western UP + Uttarakhand). Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 0.89x anchored (raw 0.74x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: Uttam Sugar Mills crushes cane at four mills (27,000 TCD: Barkatpur 8,500, Shermau 6,000, Khaikheri 5,500 in western UP; Libberheri 7,000 in Uttarakhand), sells sugar (FY26 36.8 lakh qtl at Rs 4,143/qtl, incl. a branded/specialty line), ethanol/ENA (847 lakh BL from 300 KLPD of molasses distilleries + a 40 KLPD grain distillery at 83.7%-owned UDL) and surplus power (1,006 lakh kWh to UPPCL/UPCL). Every major price is administered: cane cost is the state-set SAP (Rs 390-405/qtl for SS 2025-26, ~74% of capacity in UP), sugar has a Rs 31/kg MSP frozen since 2019 plus monthly release quotas and an export ban (13-May-2026), and ethanol is sold to OMCs at government-fixed feedstock prices. At a 9.42% recovery the SAP alone costs ~Rs 4,150 per qtl of sugar - about the sugar price - so profit comes from by-products and recovery. Group ROIC ~9% on seasonal-average capital (full-cycle ROIIC ~5.6%) is below a 12.5% cost of equity; EPS FY17 27.95 -> FY26 26.30. Variant view: Market: at Rs 348.50 (mcap Rs 1,329 cr) the stock trades at 14.7x reported TTM EPS (23.72) and 15.2x core / 10-year-average EPS (22.9-23.0) - HOT vs its own 10-year FY-end median (8.0x; 90th percentile) and NORMAL vs UP-sugar peers (Balrampur 31x, Triveni 15.5x, Dhampur 11.4x). The price rose from ~Rs 187 (2026 low) to 389 in 2026 on a domestic sugar-price spike (Rs 48 -> 56/kg Jul-Aug 2026, stock limits imposed) despite H1 FY27 PBT -62% after a flood-hit crush (-25%). Our read: no mispricing we can claim; the price already capitalises a good 2026-27 season. (1) Core EPS ~= reported (other income 5% of PBT, exceptionals -1.35 cr) - L44 check passes, unlike SHK. (2) Group ROIC ~9% and ROIIC ~5.6% < CoE, so the DCF is near zero and every scenario above 1x is an exit-multiple bet (L21); our base exit 9x (FY22-26 median) implies de-rating from 15x. (3) A material government-input change is missing from the company's own disclosures (L40): the ESY 2026-27 OMC tender (BPCL, 16-Oct-2026) seeks no ethanol from cane juice, syrup or B-heavy molasses, while three UP units ran on B-heavy and Barkatpur on syrup in SS 2025-26 and the 300 KLPD rating is 'based on B-heavy/syrup'; the 31-Oct-2026 results deck does not mention it. (4) The 2026-27 UP SAP is not yet announced (farmers ask Rs 500 vs 390-400). Evidence for the other side: ratings upgraded twice (CARE A Stable Sep-2025; India Ratings A Stable Jun-2026), debt falls to ~Rs 30 cr net each September, recovery improving (9.42% vs 8.94%), C-heavy ethanol stays eligible and lost B-heavy diversion returns as extra sugar into a tight market (closing stock ~4.25 mt), and an MSP hike (ISMA asks Rs 40-41/kg) would lift every miller. Departure from the outside view: raw P(blow-up) 10% < class 15% (A-rated, no pledge) and raw P(<=0.5x) far above 11% because the price sits at 1.9x the own-history P/E median; default w=0.5. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:UTTAMSUGAR:*. Open soft flags: 4. P(≥3x) 1% vs base 21%; P(≤0.5x) 38% vs base 11.3%; EV 5-yr multiple 0.74x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-15.

gates.result: anchoring lowered documented tails — check evidence note: P(≤0.5x)
EV 0.89x anchored (raw 0.74x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0

kill_criteria.if: UP SAP for SS 2026-27 raised by more than Rs 20/qtl without a sugar MSP increase
FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin (resolver basis) below 8%
Net debt above Rs 900 cr at 31-Mar-2027
Rating downgrade below A by CARE or India Ratings

override_log.why: L40 checked: the B-heavy/syrup ethanol exclusion is a withdrawn government input, but it does not remove a licence or lease the business depends on - C-heavy molasses ethanol stays eligible, diverted sucrose returns as saleable sugar, and the distillery is 25% of segment EBIT. The SAP is an annual administered price, not a concession. Weighed in the bear case and the blow-up note instead. Lesson candidate: the trigger is binary; partial input withdrawals need a graded field.
Pledge 0% and TTM ICR 4.1x: neither flag fires.

UP cane SAP 2026-27 pending (searched 25-Nov-2026; latest coverage 04/10-Nov-2026 says no decision); FRP 2026-27 Rs 365/qtl at 10.25% recovery (GoI, May-2026). UP molasses reservation for country liquor not verified this run (open item).
No concalls; AR mode gives n=2 dated promises (L37). Disclosure flags reported instead.
